note: Plumas-Eureka State Park's campground, in conifer forest along Jamison Creek about 5 mi west of Blairsden; the creek holds the occasional trout. The park's mining museum and historic stamp mill are nearby. --Claude
summary: Upper Jamison Creek (Plumas-Eureka SP): $35 every sampled 2027 night; season Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day (closed for 2026 since Sept 8); trailers 24 ft / motorhomes 28 ft, but no ReserveCalifornia spur over 24 ft; 58 units on ReserveCalifornia (36 drive-in, 22 tent), max stay 30; not waterfront kept.
flags: SITE COUNT 67 -> 58: ReserveCalifornia's facility is 'sites 1-70' but its grid lists 58 units (36 'Campsite', 22 'Tent Campsite'). Some numbers may be first-come or retired; nothing published accounts for 67.
FIT: parks.ca.gov 'Max trailer: 24 feet Max camper/motorhome: 28 feet'; ReserveCalifornia's longest listed spur is 24 ft (21 sites at 24, one at 23). Fine for a 23-ft rig, tight on choice.

WATERFRONT not waterfront KEPT: 'Jamison Creek flows through the campground', but the loops sit under continuous canopy and the creek runs along the west edge through trees; no per-site points exist to name any creekside site. At most creekview, so no upgrade.

STATUS: seasonal closure only ('Campground is closed starting September 8th, 2026'); the page's Current Restrictions box still says 'Upper Jamison Campground: Open for the Season' (stale). Not written as temporarily_closed.
